objective: Prefer efficiently verified continuations among actually valid sibling actions; finite unresolved searches are censored, never incorrect labels
permitted_training: Phase 1 development only; source replay paths from Phase 1 v3; never Phase 1/2/3 held-out outcomes
validation: Whole order-domain development family held apart for selection; refit all allowed development after selection

collection.selection: Prefer states with at least two nonterminal valid actions, then depth; include verified-path action and generated-order alternatives, independent of rollout outcomes
collection.cost: 1 initial accepted action + downstream attempted candidates; startup/pool observation/fresh verification separately reported
collection.labels: Only unequal measured costs of two independently verified valid continuations create outcome preferences. Unresolved, timed-out and unexplored actions are censored/unlabeled. Invalid tactics contribute only separate applicability contrasts.

representation: Pre-execution goal/context/action features, trained from scratch; no frozen Phase 2 score input or successor features/hidden Lean lookahead. Actual successors retained for analysis only.
model: Regularized multitask linear pairwise ranker, CPU; separate mean applicability loss + outcome_weight * mean valid-success cost-preference loss + L2/2 norm squared
selection_metric: Minimum order-development valid-success continuation pair loss; report insufficiency if none, no evaluation fallback

ablations.applicability_only: Identical full features and selected L2, outcome weight zero; isolates new downstream signal
ablations.old_features_outcome: Same combined objective/hyperparameters, Phase 2 representation only; isolates representation change

uncertainty.unit: independent theorem cluster; keep repeated executions together

pilot: Eight development-only tasks, BFS and handcrafted only, actual traces preserved in experiments/phase3/pilot-v1; budgets calibrated before final freeze. No model-based task selection/removal.
constraints: All final tasks retained including unsolved; unchanged generator/checker and handcrafted frontier, same primary ProofLab budgets; native Aesop separately identified. Freeze final model artifacts before any final search, no later tuning.
